TEMPOSHARE — Real-Time ETA Tracker: Share Arrival Time, Not Your Location

Share your ETA in real-time with a simple link. TempoShare is the arrival time tracker that lets you send a live ETA to anyone — no GPS position revealed, no app required for recipients. Just share the link and they see your estimated arrival time updating live.

THE PRIVACY-FIRST ETA APPROACH

Unlike other location-sharing apps, TempoShare never shows your position on a map. Recipients only see:

• A countdown timer to your arrival
• Your estimated arrival time (ETA)
• A progress bar showing how far along you are
• Whether you're moving, paused, or arriving

No map. No tracking. No breadcrumbs.

HOW IT WORKS

1️⃣ Select how you're traveling (car, bike, walk, or transit)
2️⃣ Generate a shareable ETA link instantly
3️⃣ Send it via any messaging app
4️⃣ Your recipient opens it in their browser — done!

They'll see your arrival time live, not where you are right now.

KEY FEATURES

⏱️ REAL-TIME ARRIVAL TIME TRACKING
Accurate ETA powered by Google Maps, automatically updated as you travel. Your ETA link stays live until you arrive.

🔒 LOCATION STAYS PRIVATE
Your GPS position is never displayed to recipients. They only see time-based information — no map, no route, no coordinates.

🔗 NO APP FOR RECIPIENTS
The person waiting for you just opens the ETA link in their browser. No download, no account required.

👤 NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Start sharing your arrival time immediately. No sign-up, no login, no personal data collected.

🗑️ AUTO-DELETE
All trip data is automatically deleted 24 hours after completion.

🚗 SMART TRANSPORT MODES
Optimized ETA calculations for driving, cycling, walking, or public transit.

🔋 BATTERY EFFICIENT
Adaptive GPS intervals — frequent when close, efficient when far.

⭐ FAVOURITE PLACES
Save frequent destinations for one-tap trip starts. Long-press to rename or reorder.

📲 ANDROID SHORTCUTS
Long-press the app icon to start a trip to a recent destination without even opening the app.

PERFECT FOR

• "I'm on my way" — but with actual ETA precision
• Coordinating meetups without oversharing your route
• Keeping family informed during commutes or school runs
• Service appointments, deliveries, and pickups
• Couples and roommates syncing schedules
• Anyone who values privacy but still wants to share their arrival time
